burst: Destroy Mode: Extends her line of sight and auto-aims at all enemies within range. The stage target is treated as a single enemy regardless of whether it has parts (including interruption parts).

caveats: ⚑ MG cadence tuple (pullsPerSec / reloadFrames 159 / hitsPerShot 2) is datamine-sourced and unreliable; BOTH 200-hit triggers (S1 stacks, S2 ATK) and the maxAmmoPct feedback loop are cadence-driven, so the whole kit's proc rate inherits that uncertainty. Highest-leverage measurement for this unit.

⚑ hitCount:200 is authored as 200 ROUNDS (engine convention: an MG spends hitsPerShot rounds per pull), matching the kit's 'normal attack hits 200 time(s)'. If the engine counts trigger pulls instead, the threshold halves and both procs double in frequency — verify against a buffApply-event count before trusting stack uptime.

⚑ S2 rider gate: 'during increasing Hit Rate status' has no literal schema gate (no 'requiresBuff'). Modeled as fbGate:'inFb' because the Hit Rate window is opened at FB entry for 15 s and Full Burst with her own +5 s extension is 15 s, so the two windows coincide almost exactly. This UNDER-credits the tail whenever the team enters FB without her burst (FB 10 s, HR still live for 5 s more). Alternative encodings: ungated (over-credits every out-of-FB 200-hit proc) or a resource/status channel.

⚑ hitRatePct 8.56 → core-rate lift magnitude is engine-derived (sim.ts hrCoreMult), not kit-stated; measured-only. The kit percentage is transcribed literally, but its damage consequence is an unvalidated conversion.

⚑ Burst 'Deals 2.24% of final ATK as damage for 15 sec' is modeled as a PER-HIT rider (extraHitDamagePct) for the 15 s window, not a DoT. Whole-picture: a 1 s-interval DoT would total ~34% of ATK across an entire Burst III window — implausibly negligible for a burst skill — while the per-hit read matches the identical-shaped S1 line and MG hit density. Confirm by popup count (per-hit white numbers alongside normals vs a once-per-second tick).

⚑ Max Ammunition ▼5.04% ×5 is kept (weapon-state modifier = damage): it shrinks the belt from 300 toward ~225 and raises reload frequency. It is INERT during the 15 s unlimited-ammo burst window, so its net cost depends on the burst-uptime fraction.
⚑ noFb NOT set anywhere (default ON, i.e. riders take the +50% FB major by timing). Per-kit noFb is measured-only; leaving it off is the documented default, not a finding.

⚑ Destroy Mode auto-aim is unmodeled. It plausibly changes effective hit/core landing (the real reason her burst is strong), but the kit text states no rate, so nothing was invented. If a measured Destroy-Mode core rate exists, it belongs here rather than in the 2.24% line.

Stack steady-state for the S1 pair (5 stacks × 10 s, one stack per 200 hits) is left to the engine's native stacking rather than an authored time-average; no rampSec applied. If the engine refreshes rather than re-stacks, uptime will be wrong — check maxStacks on the buffApply events.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Blind second read of the kit prose only (no board, no probe data, no committed override). Structure: S1 = an always-on per-hit rider (extraHitDamagePct 3.05) + a 200-hit self stack pair (Crit DMG ▲14.25 ×5 / Max Ammo ▼5.04 ×5, 10 s). S2 = team Hit Rate ▲8.56 for 15 s on FB entry + a self ATK ▲29.38 (10 s) 200-hit rider whose kit gate ('during increasing Hit Rate status') is approximated by fbGate:'inFb'. Burst = team Full Burst Duration ▲5 s, self unlimited ammo 15 s, and the Destroy Mode 2.24% line encoded as a 15 s per-hit rider (see caveats for the per-hit-vs-DoT reasoning). Destroy Mode's aim/line-of-sight/partless-target text is unmodeled (v1 boss is partless; no aim model). No `ignored` blocks.

audit.effectOrReason: Passive self buff extraHitDamagePct 3.05 — the schema's purpose-built 'flat % of final ATK added per normal-attack hit while active'. Equivalent to a hitCount:1 flatDamage rider but without per-hit block dispatch cost; scope is normal-attack hits only, so it never rides skill/burst damage.

audit.kitLine: Deals 3.05% of final ATK as add'l dmg
audit.effectOrReason: Magnitude of the above (3.05). Applies per HIT, so an MG at hitsPerShot 2 collects it twice per pull.
trigger {kind:'hitCount', count:200}, target self. Recurring conditional trigger — not a one-shot.
buff critDamagePct 14.25, maxStacks 5, durationSec 10. Unscoped in the prose (no 'of normal attacks'), so generic critDamagePct is the literal read.
buff maxAmmoPct -5.04, maxStacks 5, durationSec 10. Weapon-state modifier = damage (HARD RULE 6): shrinks the belt, raises reload frequency. NOT skipped as defensive.

audit.kitLine: Affects all allies. Entering Full Burst
audit.effectOrReason: trigger fullBurstEnter (literal text — fires on ANY team Full Burst, not burstCast), target {kind:'allies'} (includes self).
buff hitRatePct 8.56, durationSec 15. Hit Rate is a core-hit lift per the schema, never auto-skipped.

audit.kitLine: normal attack hits 200 during Hit Rate
audit.effectOrReason: trigger {kind:'hitCount', count:200}, target self, plus fbGate:'inFb' as the proxy for the 'during increasing Hit Rate status' condition (no buff-presence gate exists in the schema). ⚑ documented approximation, see caveats.
buff atkPct 29.38, durationSec 10 (self-scaling ATK, not casterAtkPct — the line grants the holder's own ATK %).
fullBurstExtend seconds 5 on burstCast, target allies (team-wide window extension). Stretches her own unlimited-ammo/Destroy-Mode overlap to a full 15 s FB.
unlimitedAmmo durationSec 15 on burstCast, self. Weapon-state modifier = damage; removes reloads for the window and suppresses the S1 Max-Ammo penalty while live.

audit.kitLine: Deals 2.24% of final ATK for 15 sec
audit.effectOrReason: buff extraHitDamagePct 2.24, durationSec 15 (per-hit rider for the window), NOT a dot — a 1 s-tick DoT totals ~34% ATK over the whole burst, globally inconsistent with a Burst III payload. ⚑ flagged.

audit.kitLine: Destroy Mode: extends line of sight
audit.effectOrReason: Aim/line-of-sight geometry has no engine channel and the kit states no hit/core rate for it; inventing one would violate measured>fudge. Verbatim in unmodeled.burst.

audit.kitLine: target treated as a single enemy
audit.effectOrReason: v1 scope-lock boss is partless and single-target, so the parts-collapse clause is inert by construction. Same verbatim unmodeled.burst entry.

flags.estimate: datamined MG cadence as-is; hitsPerShot 2, reloadFrames 159, ammo 300 (→ ~225 at 5 Max-Ammo stacks)
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #1: rate_of_fire and reloadFrames are known-unreliable datamine fields, and this kit is unusually cadence-sensitive — both 200-hit thresholds, the crit-damage/ammo stack uptime, and the S2 ATK uptime are all functions of hits/sec. A 10% cadence error compounds into a much larger proc-frequency error.
flags.recipe: Read her ammo counter frame-by-frame on a solo recording to get shots/sec directly (the instrument that measures the disputed quantity), not FB counts. Cross-check reload wall-clock between the last shot and the refilled counter.

flags.reasoning: The kit says 'hits', and the engine's round convention counts hitsPerShot per pull for an MG — so 200 hits ≈ 100 trigger pulls. If the engine's hitCount instead counts pulls, both procs fire twice as often and the Crit DMG / ATK uptime roughly doubles.
flags.recipe: Run controlComp('modernia') with an onEvent hook counting buffApply {stat:'critDamagePct'} and dividing battle shots by proc count; compare the shots-per-proc figure against 100 (rounds convention) vs 200 (pulls convention).

flags.estimate: 'inFb' as a proxy for 'during increasing Hit Rate status'
flags.reasoning: No schema gate reads buff presence. The Hit Rate window (15 s from FB entry) and the Full Burst window (10 s base + her own 5 s extension = 15 s) coincide when she bursts, so the proxy is near-exact on her own rotations and conservative otherwise (it drops procs in the 5 s HR tail after a non-extended FB, and any HR window she carries into the out-of-FB gap).
flags.recipe: Instrument buffApply {stat:'hitRatePct', targetSlug:'modernia'} to get the true HR window, then compare ATK-buff proc counts under fbGate:'inFb' vs ungated; if the delta is material, add a buff-presence gate to the schema rather than picking either extreme.

flags.reasoning: The prose gives a magnitude and a window but no per-tick cadence. Per-hit is the only read consistent with a Burst III payload (a 1 s DoT would be ~34% ATK total); it also mirrors the identically-worded S1 line, which the prose does mark as per-hit.
flags.recipe: Count damage popups during her burst window on a solo recording: a per-hit rider produces one extra small number per landed hit (≈2× pull rate for the MG), a DoT produces exactly 15 evenly-spaced ticks.

flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #7: the Hit Rate → core-hit-rate conversion is an engine-derived curve (hrCoreMult), measured-only. The kit percentage is exact but its damage effect is not.
flags.recipe: A/B the comp with HRCORE=0 vs default (per-PROCESS env toggle, never in-loop) and compare the team's core-bucket damage share against a footage core-popup fraction.

flags.reasoning: It is a real weapon-state modifier (more reloads = fewer shots), but it is fully suppressed during the 15 s unlimited-ammo window, so its damage cost depends on burst uptime and on whether stacks are even live at reload time. Sign matters: this is the only self-DEBUFF in the kit and a dropped minus sign would silently buff her.
flags.recipe: Assert on the buffApply value being negative (-5.04) and stacks ≤5, then compare total shots fired with the block present vs removed via withPatchedOverride.

flags.estimate: unset everywhere (riders take the +50% Full Burst major by timing)
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #6: per-kit noFb is measured-only and defaults OFF. Both extraHitDamagePct riders are large-volume, so if her per-hit damage is actually FB-exempt the over-credit inside the 15 s window would be substantial.
flags.recipe: Compare a per-hit rider popup value inside vs outside Full Burst on the same recording; a 1.5× step means FB applies, a flat value means noFb.
